vocab.definition: the gradual destruction of a metal by reaction.
the corrosion of iron, needing oxygen and water.
painting/oiling to keep out air and water.
a more reactive metal corrodes instead.

misconceptions.right: Rusting needs BOTH oxygen and water.
Only iron and steel rust; other metals corrode differently.

misconceptions.wrong: Galvanising only works as a barrier.

infoPanels.title: PREVENTING RUST
workedSteps: !Sacrificial: a more reactive metal corrodes first.
Word equation: iron + oxygen + water → hydrated iron(III) oxide.

questions.text: Name the two substances needed for iron to rust. [2 marks]
Explain how painting prevents rusting. [2 marks]
Explain how sacrificial protection stops iron from corroding. [3 marks]
State what is meant by galvanising. [1 mark]
Complete the sentence using the word bank. [2 marks]
questions.secondaryText: Rusting needs ______ and ______; galvanising coats iron with zinc.

questions.text: Explain why zinc protects iron even if the coating is scratched. [2 marks]

footer.tip: Rust needs oxygen AND water. Zinc protects iron as a barrier and sacrificially.
footer.thinkPrompt: Why does a more reactive metal corrode in preference to the iron it protects?
